text:
Muñoz Manzo y Ocampo, SC (hereinafter "MM&O"), located at Carretera México Toluca 5420 PH4, Santa Fe, CP 05320, Mexico City, in strict compliance with the provisions of the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties and its Regulations, as well as the Guidelines published by the National Institute for Transparency, Access to Information and Personal Data Protection (hereinafter "the Legislation"), hereby informs you that it may collect, store, transmit and make use of your personal, financial, patrimonial, and sensitive data, as detailed below:

Personal Data: Name, age, RFC, CURP, IMSS, INFONAVIT number, marital status, nationality.
Contact Information: Telephone number, address and email.
Professional Data: Information related to your professional practice.
Financial or Patrimonial Data: Income generated in Mexico and abroad; movable and immovable property located in Mexico or other countries.
Sensitive Data: Information you provide regarding past or current illnesses, as well as your sexual orientation and religious preferences.

The data you provide us will be used exclusively for the following purposes:
Service Delivery: we will use the data you provide us, both to prepare our service proposal and, where applicable, to deliver tax and estate-planning advisory services and support you in fulfilling various tax obligations. During the provision of services, you may disclose information about your health status or that of your dependents, as well as your sexual orientation and religious preferences.
Billing and collections: we will use your personal and contact information to issue invoices for services rendered and to manage our collection processes.

Likewise, we may use your data for the following secondary purposes:
MM&O Publications: Sharing newsletters or articles we believe may interest you via email.
Events and commemorations: Sending greetings on special dates and invitations to events organized by MM&O.

We inform you that MM&O processes your personal data in accordance with the principles of legality, consent, information, quality, purpose, loyalty, proportionality and responsibility established in the Legislation. We safeguard your data through appropriate administrative, physical and technological measures, including controlled-access databases in accordance to the provisions set forth in the Legislation. If you need more details about the means we have to protect your data , you can request it from our personal data protection department at datospersonales@mmyo.com.mx. We will not sell, lease, or rent your personal data to third parties.

If you have any questions regarding the previous point, please do not hesitate to contact our personal data protection department at the email address previously provided. In the event of a security breach affecting your personal, financial, patrimonial, or sensitive data, MM&O, through the responsible party, will notify you immediately by email so you can take the necessary measures to protect your rights. If we do not have your email address, the notification will be posted at the aforementioned address.

You may exercise your Access, Rectification, Cancellation, and Objection rights (also known as ARCO rights), by submitting a written request—using the form available at our office—to prove your identity or legal representation with an official photo ID (original and copy) and, if applicable, a power of attorney authorizing you to act on the data owner’s behalf. MM&O informs you that you may revoke your consent for processing your sensitive, personal, financial and/or patrimonial data at any time by writing to our personal data protection department at the address mentioned above, following the same formalities described in the previous paragarph. We will respond within 20 business days from the day we receive your request, and your data will be provided as simple copies, electronic files, or on-site consultation. We undertake to respond to you within a maximum period of 20 business days from the day we receive your request, which we will make available to you at our address upon proof of your identity. If you request access to your personal data, we will provide it via simple copies, electronic files, or you may review it on site. Should you wish to exercise your right of rectification, your request must be accompanied by documentation substantiating the changes you seek.

If you require further information about these prodecures, please do not hesitate to contact our personal data protection department at datospersonales@mmyo.com.mx.

In the event that we amend this privacy notice, we will inform you by email with reasonable advance notice prior to its implementation and post the updated version in prominent locations at our offices.

If you have any questions about this privacy notice, please contact our personal data protection department at the email address previously indicated.
